title: Foundation Metrics for Evaluating Effectiveness of Healthcare Conversations Powered by Generative AI
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper proposes a framework for evaluating healthcare chatbots and does not conduct specific faith/religion-based measurements. It mentions general bias and fairness, but does not analyze these in a religious context.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on proposing a framework and metrics for evaluating healthcare chatbots.
